summary: First test round for Digital-UNI AI Train MVP. Backend 8/8 pytest passing on public URL. Frontend happy-path flows verified end-to-end via mobile viewport (390x844): Home→Track→Enroll→Passenger Ticket→Credentials; Store→Add items (explore/fund/apparel)→Cart bar→Checkout→Complete Purchase→Order Confirmed with 'Paid via Credit Card' + BTC badge; Build-AI→AI Lab 6-stage pipeline→Commercialization 75/25→Discover; Sign In screen with 9 role picker, Fundraising CTA, Create Account tab. All 7 track cards render.

react_native_issues.issue: Payment method testIDs are auto-generated as 'pay-Credit Card', 'pay-Bitcoin', 'pay-Digital Wallet', 'pay-Scan Barcode' (with spaces and capitalization). Review request expected kebab-case like 'pay-credit', 'pay-bitcoin'. Functionality works (Credit Card default → Order Confirmed shows 'Paid via Credit Card'), but testIDs should be normalized to kebab-case for consistent automation.

action_items: Optional: normalize payment button testIDs to kebab-case (pay-credit-card, pay-bitcoin, pay-digital-wallet, pay-scan-barcode, pay-paypal) at index.tsx line 738. Not a functional bug — only affects test selector predictability.

Note for future test agents: track testID for Executive Leadership is 'track-exec' (not 'track-executive'). Confirmed all 7 tracks: track-aiml, track-cyber, track-exec, track-crypto, track-judge, track-lawyer, track-clerk.
Note: Commercialization CTA text is 'Discover the Full Ecosystem →' (with 'the'), not 'Discover Full Ecosystem'.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx is 1372 lines — should be split into per-screen modules (Home, Track, Enroll, Ticket, Store, Checkout, AILab, Commercialization, Discover, SignIn) for maintainability, but not blocking for MVP.
Backend correctly excludes MongoDB _id via projection in list endpoints. POST endpoints return only fields from `doc` dict so _id is not leaked. Good.
All backend endpoints validate input via Pydantic; error paths return proper 422 on missing required fields (verified).
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env — no hardcoded URLs found.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed enrollment/order/tryout/badge documents in Mongo. Not cleaned up (best-effort demo persistence per problem statement).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core happy-path flows are working. Backend uses ticket_id=DU-AIT-XXXXXX, ref_id=DU-ORD-XXXXXX / DU-TRY-{SPORT}-XXXX / DU-BADGE-{COURSE}-XXXX formats. Track testIDs are shortened form (track-exec, not track-executive). Payment testIDs contain spaces (pay-Credit Card etc.) — use exact string match. Tryout entry testID is 'tryout-cta' on Store screen. Program picker uses 'program-prof' / 'program-exec'. Sample-course quiz has no UI entry per problem statement — skip.
